root_cause_analysis: The Instagram Graph API returned a 429-like 'Application request limit reached' error (code 4, subcode 2207051), indicating the account or application has exceeded the allowed frequency of publishing actions within the current window.
actionable_instructions: Wait for at least 60 minutes before attempting to re-publish to allow the rate limit window to reset.
Verify if other automated scripts or third-party tools are concurrently accessing the Instagram Graph API for this account.
If the issue persists after 24 hours, check the Meta Business Suite for any account-level restrictions or 'Action Blocked' notifications.
